verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents explicit bulk actions such as multi-select status changes or batch API endpoints. There are only adjacent signals: rule-based automatic error assignment that applies across many errors, error-status filters that scope sets of errors, and retroactive tools to redact or remove sensitive data across stored events. Missing for 10: documented bulk status/assign/ignore actions across multiple errors, a bulk-capable public API or MCP tool for batch operations, and hands-on corroboration.
